finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: If the URL is dynamically constructed from user input or configuration, it could lead to OS command injection.
finding.assumptions: The URL is not hardcoded and is influenced by user input or configuration.

finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: If email_data->size is manipulated to be larger than the actual data, memcpy could overflow the buffer.
finding.assumptions: EmailData struct is properly managed and size is always accurate.

finding.title: Weak Cryptography
finding.sink: Sending data over HTTP without encryption.
finding.trigger: If email_data_str contains sensitive information, it will be sent over an unencrypted connection.
finding.assumptions: Email content does not contain sensitive information.

finding.title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
finding.sink: Sending data to a web server that may not sanitize the input.
finding.trigger: If the server does not properly sanitize the input, it could lead to XSS.
finding.assumptions: The server properly sanitizes all inputs.
